description: Atomically fill username/password fields from a server-side secret alias and submit the login form. Pass only refs and the secret alias; secret values are never accepted as tool input or returned.

password_ref.description: Password field ref, e.g. e12, from browser_snapshot.

secret.description: Secret alias from the server-side secrets vault.

submit_ref.description: Submit button ref. If omitted, the password field's enclosing form is submitted.

username_ref.description: Username field ref. Filled only when provided and the secret has a username.

name: browser_login
